title: Stumps pe lagi, phir bhi NOT OUT kaise?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] DRS me ball stumps ko CHHOO rahi thi...
Pad ke baad ka raasta... sirf ANDAAZA hai.
Isliye aadhi se zyada ball stumps pe chahiye.
Usse kam? Umpire ka faisla hi chalega!
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
DRS ki ball-tracking me ball stumps ko chhoo rahi thi... phir bhi screen pe NOT OUT. Gussa aata hai na? 🏏

Raaz: "Umpire's call".
• Ball pad pe lagne ke baad ka raasta ball-tracking ka andaaza (prediction) hota hai, aur andaaze me thodi galti ho sakti hai. Batter stumps se jitna door, galti ka chance utna zyada.
• Isliye maidan ke umpire ka LBW faisla tabhi badalta hai jab ball ka aadhe se zyada hissa "wicket zone" (stumps ki chaudaai, neeche se bails ke upar tak) ko hit kare.
• Aadha ya usse kam? Toh umpire's call: maidan wale umpire ka faisla hi chalega, chahe OUT ho ya NOT OUT.

ICC ne 2021 me wicket zone ko bails ke upar tak badhaya, par umpire's call hataya nahi.

IND vs NZ Test series me bhi DRS pe behes chal rahi hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: umpire's call hatna chahiye? Comment karo 👇
